text:

### **LM Studio (Local/Private Models)**
These models are running on your local machine. They are generally free to use (no per-token cost) but depend on your hardware.

*   **Chat & Reasoning:**
    *   **Gemma-4 26B (Various versions):** High-performance models with context windows ranging from 40K to 200K.
    *   **Qwen Series:** Includes **Qwen3.6 35B** (120K context), **Qwen3 35B**, **Qwen3 Coder 30B**, and several **Qwen3.5 9B** variants.
    *   **Nemotron-3 Nano:** A very large context model (260K).
*   **Specialized Tools:**
    *   **bge-m3:** For text embeddings.
    *   **bge-reranker-v2-m3:** For local reranking tasks.

### **OpenAI (Cloud-based Models)**
These are high-performance cloud models. Note that these incur costs based on usage.

*   **GPT-4o (Probe):** High-intelligence model (128K context).
*   **GPT-4o mini:** A faster, more efficient version of GPT-4o (128K context).
*   **Kokoro (Local/OpenAI):** A text-to-speech (TTS) model.

### **Search & Specialized Services**
*   **SearxNG:** A web search tool for real-time information.

**Summary of Capabilities:**
*   **For long-form writing/context:** Gemma-4 26B (200K) or Nemotron-3 Nano (260K).
*   **For complex reasoning/logic:** GPT-4o or the Qwen3 35B models.
*   **For quick, lightweight tasks:** Qwen2.5 7B or GPT-4o mini.
